answer: Reciprocity-weighted attestation scores a review by what the reviewer risks in return, and linking two identities to one operator resets both to zero, so a lazy farm that reuses one reviewer across 50 keys ends with 50 blank records. Cause: the rotating auditor pool draws from outside the cluster; effect: the nebula of sibling keys runs out of outside reviewers, so the velvet of mutual praise it built lands at zero weight inside a canyon of empty history.
